map.单样本 L = −[y·ln p + (1 − y)·ln(1 − p)]；批量: Single-sample L = -[y·ln p + (1 - y)·ln(1 - p)]; batch L = single-sample x n
map.二分类交叉熵对 confident 且错误的预测给出极大惩罚（p→0 而 y=1: Binary cross-entropy heavily penalizes confident yet wrong predictions (tends to infinity when p->0 but y=1); its gradient is simple (p - y) and backprop through sigmoid is very clean. In implementation, watch the eps clipping on p to prevent log(0).
map.p 应裁剪至 (ε,1−ε) 避免 log(0)。: Clip p to (ε,1-ε) to avoid log(0).
map.二分类交叉熵 CE=−[y·log(p)+(1−y)·log(1−p)]，y∈{: Binary CE = -[y·log(p)+(1-y)·log(1-p)], y in {0,1}, p is the predicted positive-class probability.
map.多分类用 −Σyᵢlog(pᵢ)，要求 p 经 softmax 且和为 1。: Multi-class uses -Σyᵢlog(pᵢ), requiring p from softmax and summing to 1.
map.CE 对错误预测惩罚重(对数放大)，是分类模型训练的标准损失。: CE heavily penalizes wrong predictions (logarithmic amplification) and is the standard loss for classification training.
map.真实 y=1，预测 p=0.9 → CE=−log(0.9)=0.105；若 p: True y=1, predicted p=0.9 -> CE=-log(0.9)=0.105; if p=0.1 -> CE=-log(0.1)=2.303. The more wrong the prediction, the larger the loss, driving the model to correct.
map.为什么用交叉熵而不是均方误差？: Why use cross-entropy instead of mean squared error?
map.CE 对概率错误更敏感且在 sigmoid/softmax 下梯度更优，MSE: CE is more sensitive to probability errors and has better gradients under sigmoid/softmax; MSE on probabilities saturates and converges slowly; CE is the log-likelihood loss naturally matched to classification.
map.p 为 0 或 1 会怎样？: What happens when p is 0 or 1?
map.log(0) 得 −∞ 导致数值爆炸。实践中对 p 做裁剪(clip 到 ε~1: log(0) yields -infinity and causes numerical explosion. In practice clip p (to ε~1-ε) or use a numerically stable logits-based implementation (compute softmax directly from raw scores) to avoid it.
map.二元交叉熵（本页代码口径，完整公式）：单样本 L=−(y×ln p+(1−y)×: Binary cross-entropy (this page's code, full formula): per-sample L=−(y×ln p+(1−y)×ln(1−p)) (y the true label 0/1, p the predicted probability); batch loss = per-sample L × sample count n. Validation: no strict checks; empty values count as 0; a non-finite result (e.g. p=0 or 1 makes the log diverge) prompts "Some results are undefined… please check the input".
map.交叉熵判读（与上框公式同源的解读口径）：L 恒非负，预测概率越贴近真实标签损失越: Cross-entropy interpretation (same basis as the formula box above): L is always non-negative, and the closer the predicted probability to the true label the smaller the loss — with y=1, p→1 gives L→0 and p→0 gives L→∞; random guessing p=0.5 gives per-sample L=ln2≈0.693. The batch value is n times the per-sample value, so divide the mean by n to recover it; training aims to minimize the cross-entropy loss.
